_comment: Default tissue material library for skeleton/topology import (orchard_fem.io.skeleton_import.DEFAULT_MATERIALS). Edit HERE to change material properties — no need to touch importer code. Moduli/densities are tuned so the composite cylindrical section (pith core 15% radius, phloem outer 8%, xylem ring between) yields the bench-calibrated GREEN-WOOD effective bending modulus E ~= 4.70 GPa and density rho ~= 650 kg/m3 for Prunus cerasifera (Liu et al., Biosystems Engineering 2026). Earlier dry-wood values (xylem 10 GPa, rho 750) made the composite ~1.6x too stiff.
